title: 1v1 lobby creation and acceptance concurrency

behavior.case: four repeated races: two independent processes challenge the same creator with different opponents
assertions: exactly one pending invitation is committed per creator
exactly one duel row and one creator membership lock exist
neither invited opponent is locked before consent
declining the winning invitation releases the creator lock

behavior.case: two independent processes Accept the same invitation at the same revision
assertions: exactly one process starts the duel
the invitation revision advances exactly once
exactly two physical player membership locks exist
the saved DuelState contains each player exactly once
acceptance creates no fabricated action receipt or transition event

isolation.database: Temporary SQLite in the OS temp directory
isolation.processes: Separate Node 22 processes with a filesystem start barrier

invariants.expected: byte-equivalent row snapshots before and after each race

limitations: The test validates the actual SQLite-backed store from separate Node processes, not a live Discord guild/gateway.
A database-busy rejection is accepted only as a fail-closed loser; CI must still prove exactly one committed winner.
